The doctor is very kind, polite, and friendly. The prices are excellent. I highly recommend this place!
More information:
Pisit Clinic, located in Soi Ban Dok Mai (near Worachak and Khlong Thom), is considered a legendary clinic, especially among older generations and people in inner Bangkok.
Here's some history and interesting facts about the clinic:
The Beginning and Reputation
The Era: This clinic has been operating for many decades (probably more than 40-50 years), since a time when access to specialist dermatologists wasn't as widespread as it is today.
Expertise: It's widely known for its "treatment of skin diseases," including acne, melasma, freckles, rashes, and various chronic skin conditions.
Unique Feature: Pisit Clinic's defining characteristic is its own "medications," especially its acne treatment solution and moisturizing creams, which many people recommend as "effective" at affordable prices compared to modern beauty clinics.
Atmosphere and Charm of the Clinic
Classic: The clinic is located in an old shophouse in Soi Ban Dok Mai. The interior retains the simple atmosphere of an old-fashioned clinic, without luxurious decorations. But the focus is on friendly and personalized treatment.
Waiting lines: In the past (and even today), it's known for its very long queues. Some people have to wait from early morning to get a chance to see a doctor. Even ordering medication by mail for customers from other provinces is very popular.
Why has it survived?
Even though there are many beauty clinics in shopping malls nowadays, Pisit Clinic still maintains a loyal customer base for several main reasons:
Treatment results: Targeted treatments and uniquely formulated medications.
Affordable prices: The cost of treatment and medication is not high, making it accessible to all groups.
Word of mouth: From generation to generation, children are often brought to see the doctor here, following in their parents' footsteps.
Additional note: Soi Ban Dok Mai itself has a long history. It's an old community famous for making fireworks and firecrackers in the past. Going to see a doctor here is like stepping back in time to experience the atmosphere of old Bangkok. I'll take pictures and share them later.
